package.description: Convert Lotus 1-2-3 spreadsheets locally to XLSX, PDF, CSV, and more.

en-US.description: Convert Lotus 1-2-3 spreadsheets locally to XLSX, PDF, CSV, and more.
en-US.longDescription:
Bulk-convert legacy Lotus 1-2-3 spreadsheets (.123, .wk1, .wk3, .wk4, .wks) to XLSX, PDF, HTML, Markdown, CSV, XLS, and SQLite locally on Windows.
LibreOffice is bundled with the installer, so no additional software is required.
en-US.name: Lotus 1-2-3 File Converter
